description: Opaque forest-green floor-length overdress with a low square neckline over a cream linen underdress. Tailored bodice and elbow-length upper sleeves have broad gold Celtic knotwork borders, repeated down the front and around the hem. Cream inner sleeves show at the elbows and wrists. Two large round gold brooches fasten the shoulder straps. A woven waist belt carries round metal ornaments and a central shaped clasp. A green patterned fringed shawl rests on both forearms and hangs down the sides. Cream underdress is visible in the lower front opening, with brown closed leather footwear. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
